landmarks.name: Malé Friday Mosque
landmarks.writeup: An iconic 17th-century mosque known for its intricate coral stone carvings and Islamic architecture.

landmarks.name: Hulhumalé Island
landmarks.writeup: A reclaimed island developed to alleviate housing shortages in Malé, featuring modern infrastructure and beaches.

landmarks.name: Banana Reef
landmarks.writeup: One of the oldest known dive sites in the Maldives, famous for vibrant coral reefs and diverse marine life.

landmarks.name: Manta Point
landmarks.writeup: A popular diving spot where divers can observe manta rays in their natural habitat.

landmarks.name: Utheemu Ganduvaru
landmarks.writeup: Historical residence of Sultan Mohamed Thakurufaanu, a national hero who liberated the Maldives from Portuguese rule.

cultural_events.name: Eid-ul-Fitr
cultural_events.writeup: A major Islamic festival marking the end of Ramadan, celebrated with prayers, feasts, and community gatherings.

cultural_events.name: Independence Day
cultural_events.writeup: Celebrated on July 26th, commemorating Maldives' independence from British protection in 1965.

cultural_events.name: Maldivian New Year
cultural_events.writeup: Known as 'Raajje Reethi,' it marks the beginning of the new year according to the Islamic calendar with traditional music and dance.

cultural_events.name: Fish Festival
cultural_events.writeup: An annual event promoting the fishing industry, featuring seafood tastings and cultural performances.

food_writeup: Maldivian cuisine is rich in seafood, coconut, and starches like rice and breadfruit. Popular dishes include Mas Huni (tuna with coconut), Garudhiya (fish broth), and various curries flavored with local spices.
brief_history: The Maldives has a history dating back over 2,500 years, influenced by South Asian, Arab, and African cultures. It became a sultanate in the 12th century and was a British protectorate from 1887 until gaining full independence in 1965. It is now a republic with a growing tourism industry.

important_people.name: Ibrahim Nasir
important_people.description: Former President who led Maldives to independence.

important_people.name: Sultan Mohamed Thakurufaanu
important_people.description: National hero who expelled Portuguese colonizers.

current_conflicts: The Maldives faces challenges related to climate change, particularly rising sea levels threatening its low-lying islands. There are no active armed conflicts.
